extraction_scope: Source-reviewed worker-6 mechanism adjudication from main-text methods/results and supplementary figure captions.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper directly tests bacterial cytoplasmic membrane disruption in Staphylococcus aureus using propidium iodide uptake flow cytometry at approximately 0.5 x MBC.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: melittin, Lys-substituted melittin analogs, and melittin dimers
mechanism_claims.limitations: Exact per-bar figure values are not provided as a table; the source supports qualitative/direct membrane-disruption classification and selected textual percentages.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper directly tests Escherichia coli membrane permeabilization with the same propidium iodide uptake assay, showing lower disruption for analogs/dimers than native melittin despite retained antimicrobial activity.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: melittin, Lys-substituted melittin analogs, and melittin dimers
mechanism_claims.limitations: The mechanism remains membrane-permeabilization supported, but the authors caution that E. coli killing may not be explained by lysis alone.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Structure/activity interpretation is indirect: side-chain shortening and dimerization alter activity and toxicity profiles, but conformational mechanism is not directly resolved in this paper.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No direct structural conformation assay was reported for these analogs in this paper.
